clips.title: The story
paras: Proving Your Worth is a crucial step in Sven Yorgen's campaign for revenge in western Duskwood. Before allowing an adventurer to confront the necromancer Morbent Fel directly, the grieving hermit demands proof that they can overcome the undead legions infesting Raven Hill Cemetery.

Sven Yorgen hides in a secluded camp north of the howling woods, consumed by grief and fury over the slaughter of his family. He has pieced together that the shadowy Dark Riders who razed his homestead were allied with a sinister necromancer named Morbent Fel. Though Sven hungers for retribution, he is not reckless enough to throw an untried recruit directly into Fel's grasp. He demands a display of sheer combat mastery against the skeletal forces occupying Raven Hill Cemetery.

To satisfy Sven, adventurers must push deep into the necropolis of Raven Hill, south of Forlorn Rowe. The mausoleum and the surrounding grounds crawl with restless corpses bound by Fel's foul magic: sword-wielding Skeletal Raiders patrol the tombstones, while Skeletal Warders and Healers tend the darker chambers beneath the earth. Clearing this vanguard is a bloody chore, especially with horrors like the vengeful phantom Mor'Ladim prowling the cemetery paths.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Morbent Fel is a necromancer, and an ally to the dark riders. I would pit you against the power of Morbent Fel, but I will not send you against that vile fiend without first knowing your strength.
You have already proven your bravery to me, but if you truly wish to face the necromancer, then you must now prove your skill against his minions.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Battle hard, friend. And do not despair, for despair is evil's greatest weapon.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your skill in combat, Friend, can not be doubted. Your resolve may yet see us through to the end of Morbent Fel!
